verdict.rationale: Increase's compliance docs describe representing customers as Entities and surfacing validation results via API, with guidance that the ops team should 'follow up with your customer when the validation indicates a data issue' — a hint at division of responsibility between Increase and the platform. But there is no evidence of an actual onboarding queue view, reasons-for-pending display, or a document-upload/request workflow for ops. Missing for 10: dashboard onboarding queue UI, pending-reason visibility, document collection/upload flow, and explicit description of which decisions Increase makes vs. the customer.
